      • bukkit

        @Nullable
public static org.bukkit.NamespacedKey bukkit(@Nonnull
                                                        io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.libraries.keys.NamespacedKey key)
        Converts one of the addon's version-safe keys to the real org.bukkit.NamespacedKey required by the (1.14+) PersistentData API. Returns null on legacy servers (1.8–1.13) where org.bukkit.NamespacedKey is absent, so the PDC boundary degrades to a no-op instead of throwing at load.
